findings.evidence: Determinant.lean:42-50 versus upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Determinant/Basic.lean:817-826, where `det_fin_three` uses the same `simp only … ; ring` shape with a much shorter list.
findings.fix: Keep only the lemmas that drive the expansion and let simp find the rest: `rw [det_succ_row_zero]; simp [det_fin_three, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.succAbove]; ring` (non-`only` simp), dropping the enumerated normal-form lemmas.
findings.issue: `det_fin_four` is closed by a `simp (disch := decide) only` enumerating ~25 simp-normal-form lemmas (`Fin.coe_ofNat_eq_mod`, `Fin.succAbove_of_le_castSucc`, `Even.neg_pow`, `Odd.neg_one_pow`, `Finset.sum_neg_distrib`, `Fin.reduceCastSucc`, …). Mathlib's own `det_fin_three` needs 12 names; a list this long is the part most likely to break on an upstream rename or normal-form change, and none of the names carries meaning for the reader.

findings.evidence: `grep -n 'kWit4_p_q' code/` returns only the declaration at Tensor.lean:414; Tensor.lean:465-467 passes `(by simp) (by simp)` for the `hM`/`hpq` arguments.
findings.fix: Use the named facts at the call site — `(by rw [kWit4_M2]; norm_num)` and `(by rw [kWit4_p_q]; exact one_ne_zero)` — matching how `spinUniquenessWit` (lines 451, 456) consumes its probe lemmas; or delete `kWit4_p_q` if it is not meant to be part of the witness API.
findings.issue: `kWit4_p_q : ηWit kWit4.p kWit4.q = 1` is never used anywhere in the repo, while the one place that needs that side condition, `fromG1G2_kWit4_ne_zero` (line 467), discharges `ηWit kWit4.p kWit4.q ≠ 0` and `0 < kWit4.M2 ηWit` with two anonymous `(by simp)` terms that re-derive the numerics from the simp set.

summary: Proofs are short, structured, and free of undocumented defeq manipulation; the two `vecCons`/`det`-unfolding steps both carry accurate explanatory comments. Two non-blocking notes: a 25-name `simp only` in `det_fin_four`, and a stated-but-unused witness lemma that the one call site re-derives with an anonymous `by simp`.
